item.title: Version 1.1.0
item.description: TorPal 1.1.0: everything other torrent clients had that TorPal didn't (FEATURES.md). - Copy Magnet Link and Export .torrent File (right-click). - Add sheet: skip the check when the files are already there; content layout (as in the torrent / always in a folder / without its folder). - Window › Statistics: all-time totals (removed torrents included), this session, now. - When a download finishes: run a Shortcut or a script (Settings › Downloads). - When everything is done: sleep or shut down, once, after a minute's notice (File menu, menu bar). - Peers: Ban Peer (unban in Settings › Network › Blocklist). Inspector › Options: Super seeding. - Settings › Downloads: reserve each file's full size on disk. - I2P: torrents from I2P trackers download over I2P (router in Docker, or your own). - TorPal in Arabic: Settings › General › Language.

item.title: Version 1.0.9
item.description: TorPal 1.0.9: edit trackers; public trackers. - Inspector › Trackers: Add Trackers… (one per line), right-click Edit… / Copy Address / Remove, Ask for Peers. - Settings › Network › Public trackers (off by default): a public tracker list, refreshed daily, added to new downloads and, on request, to current ones. Never to torrents from private trackers. - Every tracker of a torrent is now asked for peers, not just the first that answers.

item.title: Version 1.0.8
item.description: TorPal 1.0.8: RSS feeds with auto-download rules. - Feeds in the sidebar: add your tracker's RSS address (kept in the Keychain, since it carries your passkey); see each feed's latest items and download any of them. - Rules…: words a title must and mustn't have (Arabic spellings and dots don't matter; regular expressions if you like), which feeds, once per episode, a label, a folder, add paused, a size cap, and a live preview of what it matches. - The helper checks the feeds on their schedule with the window closed and notifies you when a rule adds something. What was already in a feed is only taken if you ask.

item.title: Version 1.0.7
item.description: TorPal 1.0.7: buttons for everything the engine could already do. - Inspector › Options: where a download is and where it goes when done (Move To…, Change Destination…), its own speed limits, its own seeding goal, Rename…. - Right-click a torrent: Rename…, Move To… (several at once), Label › New Label…. - Files: right-click a file › Rename…. Peers: Add Peer… (IP:port). - File › Create Torrent… (⇧⌘N), also in the + menu: make a .torrent of a file or folder and seed it. - Labels: + in the sidebar, right-click › Edit Label…: name, color, the folder finished downloads move to, a seeding goal, Delete.

item.title: Version 1.0.6
item.description: TorPal 1.0.6: - Clear Completed: a toolbar button that takes finished torrents off the list and leaves their files where they are. Private-tracker torrents stay until they've seeded 72 hours and to a ratio of 1.0. - Internet Archive downloads that stopped at 99.x% now finish even when archive.org's old server names in the torrent no longer answer: after 3 minutes with nothing arriving, the last pieces come straight from archive.org and are checked against its checksums.

item.title: Version 1.0.5
item.description: TorPal 1.0.5: - Internet Archive downloads no longer stop at 99.x%. archive.org changes some of an item's files after making its torrent, so a few pieces could never be verified. TorPal now skips those pieces, fetches their bytes straight from archive.org, and checks each repaired file against archive.org's own checksum before calling it done. Downloads already stuck finish on their own after the update. - archive.org's bookkeeping files (_meta.xml, thumbnails) are no longer downloaded.

item.title: Version 1.0.4
item.description: TorPal 1.0.4 (includes the never-published 1.0.2 and 1.0.3): - Pause All and the toolbar pause button really pause torrents now; with rows selected they act on those rows. - Search has a Books filter next to Any, Movies and TV. - Download from Web Page leaves out dead links and pages that aren't videos. - After an update the background helper restarts, so fixes take effect right away. - Failed saves (Keychain keys, settings, watch folder) now say so instead of failing silently. - Security: a hostile web page can no longer crash, stall or redirect the helper.

item.title: Version 1.0.1
item.description: Sites added through TorPal now try each address the site lists and keep the one that works, and get seed ratio 1.0 filled in (plus 72 hours seed time for private sites). Sites already in Prowlarr get the seed ratio too.

item.title: Version 1.0.0
item.description: TorPal 1.0. Default peer connections are now 500 (installs still at the old 200 move up once). A search result that's already in your list shows ✓ Added instead of an error.

item.description: Search: the seeds filter is now a menu (Any, 1+, 3+, 5+, 10+, 25+, 50+, 100+) instead of steps of 5.

item.title: Version 0.4.3
item.description: Clear the search: the ✕ in the search field (or Esc) now clears the results too. Settings › Search › Clear Search History… forgets past results, the release names behind instant results, title lookups and learned names. Other Downloads has Clear Finished.

item.title: Version 0.4.2
item.description: New: sites behind Cloudflare. Turn on Settings › Search › Get past Cloudflare's browser check and TorPal runs FlareSolverr in Docker on this Mac (it opens Docker Desktop if it isn't running; the first time downloads a few hundred MB) and connects it to its Prowlarr. Then run Add Public Sites again to add the sites that were blocked. Also: release builds are now checked to come from one exact commit.

item.title: Version 0.4.1
item.description: Fixes: when a site says it's getting too many requests (HTTP 429), Download now waits and retries, each .torrent is fetched only once, and a failure shows on that result with Retry instead of replacing the results. Settings redesigned like System Settings: a sidebar with coloured icons, values next to their controls, and your sources first in Settings › Search. The torrent list remembers how you sorted it.

item.title: Version 0.4.0
item.description: New look: the torrent list shows each download with an icon for what it is, a readable name (El Batal · S01E05 with 1080p, WEB-DL tags), a coloured progress bar and the numbers that matter, under live download and upload graphs; the old table is one click away in the toolbar. Search has a big search field, suggestions, result cards with score rings and coloured quality tags, and a Telegram card. New inspector, Other Downloads, menu bar panel and setup assistant. Fix: results found by earlier searches no longer disappear when the first site answers.

item.title: Version 0.3.1
item.description: Sites to search in your browser: save the sites you search yourself, and Search shows a button for each one (plus Open All) that opens that site's own search for what you typed, in your browser. To add a site, search it for torpal and paste the results page address, or paste just the site's address to search it through Google.

item.title: Version 0.3.0
item.description: Arabic sources: Sites with an Account (ArabP2P and others; sign up, then enter just your login, and private torrents keep seeding to ratio 1.0 or 72 hours); Arabic-aware search (also tries Arabic, ArSub, Shahid and مدبلج tags); Internet Archive built in for classic films; SubSource Arabic subtitles alongside SubDL; Telegram: sign in with your own account to search and download videos from your channels and groups (Settings › Telegram); Download from Web Page (⇧⌘D) into the new Other Downloads list. Also: Add Public Sites in one click, a SubDL key check, and a new app icon.

item.title: Version 0.2.1
item.description: Beta fixes: Prowlarr no longer fails when its port is taken (it moves to a free one) and start errors show right away; the TMDB token is checked when you save it, with a Test button in Settings › Search and a live check in Diagnostics (the short TMDB API Key works too).

item.title: Version 0.2.0
item.description: Beta: speed profiles, battery and heat back-off, VPN lock and kill switch, IP blocklist, phone remote control, diagnostics, setup assistant, settings export/import, Quick Look, Finder tags and auto-rename, custom indexer definitions, Arabic subtitle hints, crash reports.
